d: As the final operational window closes and field equipment is packed, activity in the Oregon wilderness spikes to an unprecedented high. This climactic compilation gathers the high-stakes final cut sequences from Expedition Bigfoot, showing the exact moments the final hunt uncovers bigfoot sightings moving rapidly through the timber. Armed with military-grade forward-looking infrared and directional acoustic arrays, the ground team’s relentless search ends with real bigfoot evidence captured right on the edge of basecamp. Watch the nerve-wracking finale unfold as the crew concludes…
